2607.09755.title: LegalFarePlan: A Label-Setting Framework for Fare-Transparent Urban Rail Route Planning under Non-Additive Fare Rules
2607.09755.paper_summary: Urban rail fare systems may be non-additive: the fare of a single paid journey from an origin to a destination can differ from the sum of fares over multiple legally separated journey legs. This paper presents LegalFarePlan, a fare-transparent route-planning framework that models legal exit-and-reentry operations as explicit, auditable constraints. Given a transit network, fare function, transfer rules, station-level exit/re-entry costs, an extra-time budget, and a split limit, the planner computes explainable route plans over paid journey segments. The artifact implements Dijkstra shortest-time and direct route-planner baselines, a greedy split heuristic, bounded exact label-setting, and Pareto-frontier search. Evaluation uses controlled synthetic data and a 57-station semi-synthetic benchmark with 360 OD pairs. On the semi-synthetic benchmark, bounded exact search identifies positive modeled fare reductions for 71.11% of OD pairs, with mean reduction 3.78 and maximum reduction 9.0 synthetic fare units under a 45-minute extra-time budget. These results demonstrate method behavior and reproducibility; they are not empirical conclusions about MTR or any transit operator.
2607.09755.paper_summary_zh: 城市鐵路票價系統可能是非可加的：從起點到終點的單次付費行程的票價可能與多個合法分開行程的票價總和不同。本文提出了LegalFarePlan，一個票價透明的路徑規劃框架，將合法的退出和重新進入操作建模為明確的、可審計的約束條件。給定一個交通網絡、票價函數、轉乘規則、車站層級的退出/重新進入成本、一個額外時間預算和一個分割限制，規劃者計算可解釋的付費行程段的路徑計劃。該工具實現了Dijkstra最短時間和直接路徑規劃基準、一個貪婪的分割啟發式、有限的精確標籤設置和帕累托邊界搜索。評估使用受控的合成數據和一個57站的半合成基準，包含360個OD對。在半合成基準上，有限精確搜索為71.11%的OD對識別出正向模型票價減少，平均減少3.78，最大減少9.0個合成票價單位，基於45分鐘的額外時間預算。這些結果展示了方法的行為和可重複性；它們不是關於MTR或任何交通運營商的實證結論。
2607.09755.author: Tanghui Li et.al.
